title: Verena Labs rapid onramp notes
content:
Context: quick-turn pilot for Verena Labs (health analytics startup). Goal is a private VPC deployment with strict PII controls, 99.9% availability SLA for inference endpoints, and predictable 95th-percentile latency under 120ms for 512-token responses. They want first demo in 3 weeks, production in ~10 weeks if no blockers.

Call summary (2025-11-03 initial intake):
- Attendees: Priya (Rdw), Miguel (Rdw), Arjun Patel (Verena CTO), Laila Mendes (Verena infra), Benji (Verena ML eng).
- High-level ask: embed LLM-powered triage assistant into internal case review UI (on-prem data sources, tight PHI rules).
- Traffic profile: approx 60 rps peak across 3 models (reranker + generator + embeddings) during business hours. Expected growth 2x in 6 months.
- Data residency: customer must keep logs inside their VPC, no outbound logging to hosted plane. Audit logs required for all API calls for 90 days.
- Ops: Verena runs their own K8s cluster (EKS) with isolated tenant namespaces. They prefer Redwood Private deployment with customer-managed control plane.

Technical requirements captured:
1) Networking
- Private control plane option: must support no egress to Redwood-managed networks for inference payloads and logs.
- Forward proxy / NAT considerations: Laila says egress is blocked by default, will open to specific IPs after security review.
- Need clear list of IPs and TLS cert pinning guidance by next week.

2) Security & Compliance
- KMS integration: customer KMS (Azure Key Vault) for model keys and service certs. Redwood requires KMS plugin doc + sample terraform.
- HSM optional for FIPS workloads in later phases.
- Audit logging: immutable logs in S3-compatible storage in their VPC (min 90 days).

3) Performance & SLOs
- Target p95 latency <120ms for 512-token generator calls. For now, we'll provision dedicated capacity + autoscale headroom.
- Need test harness to run synthetic traffic (we should provide simple k6 script).
- Caching: recommend enabling prefix KV cache for repeated templates; show expected cost delta.

4) Models & Quality
- Initial model: curated open decoder (quantized) for generation + CPU-based lightweight reranker.
- Verena concerned about hallucinations on structured outputs — propose guarded parsing + model output validators in pipeline.

5) Observability & Rollouts
- Console access to token-level cost and latency breakdowns for their SREs.
- Rollout plan: canary -> 25% -> 50% -> 100% over 48 hours with automatic fallback to smaller model if regressions detected.

Call notes (raw, things to follow up):
- Benji: "We can't risk any model outputs being written to external telemetry. Is the inference CPU/GPU metrics view exportable to their S3?" Action: verify whether metrics exports include payloads (no) and document exports config.
- Arjun: wants sample SLA language for Dedicated/Private with uptime and P95 guarantees. Action: roadmap legal + solutions to draft an appendix.
- Laila: "We need to run an internal security pentest against Redwood Private agent before we open K8s ports." Action: provide agent install docs and threat model checklist.

Gotchas / risks (quick list):
- Networking gating factor: until security approves IP list, we can't complete installation. Schedule dependency ~1 week risk.
- Model quantization: some of their post-processing expects fp16 logits — mismatch could require small adapter layer.
- Audit retention: 90-day immutable logs in their storage could bump storage costs; need to run storage estimate.
- Rate pattern surprises: 60 rps average with short bursts might cause tail latency; recommend burst capacity policy in Dedicated profile.

Open questions to clarify on next call: (assign owners)
- Who signs off on KMS integration? (Owner: Arjun)
- Confirm exact SLO language and penalty thresholds for SLA appendix (Owner: Priya + Legal)
- Are there any internal model governance rules that forbid use of third-party model weights? (Owner: Benji)
- Does Verena want logs anonymized or fully PII-preserving? (Owner: Laila)

Immediate next steps (timeline oriented):
- Within 48 hours: send IP list and TLS cert guidance doc (owner: Priya) [ETA 2025-11-05].
- By EOW (2025-11-07): hand off Private agent install guide + threat model checklist to Verena SREs (owner: Miguel).
- By 2025-11-14: deliver k6 test harness + sample traffic profile and run first synthetic run with customer in staging (owner: Miguel & Benji).
- Week of 2025-11-24: first demo in staging with generator + reranker, show latency/cost tradeoffs (owner: Priya + Benji).
- 10-week target (2026-01-12): production-ready deployment if no critical blockers.

Notes to self:
- Prep a short one-pager: "Redwood Private for PHI workloads — install checklist". Keep <2 pages. Link to template in Confluence.
- Build a cost estimate table (per-hour GPU, storage audit logs, egress if any) and include best/worst-case scenarios.
- Flag Legal early for SLA appendix; don't promise p95 numbers until infra sizing done.

Useful references to attach to next email:
- Private agent install quickstart (internal doc id: rdw-internal://private/agent-quickstart)
- KMS integration sample terraform repo: github.com/redwood-inference/kms-samples (internal)
- Example SLA appendix (template): confluence://templates/sla-appendix

Email/Slack draft snippet to send after call: "Thanks Arjun/Laila/Benji — great kickoff. We captured initial constraints and next steps (IP list + agent guide + k6 harness). We’ll follow up with the install checklist and SLA appendix template. Priya/Miguel to own next week deliverables."

End of scratchpad. Will convert to formal onboarding doc once security signs off on IP list and we run the staging traffic test.
